_readme: Hand-maintained slow-macro inputs with no free API. Edit, commit, and Vercel redeploys. status: green | amber | red. 'updated' is when you last checked; entries older than max_age_days show as stale. Bank failures are pulled automatically from the FDIC.

private_credit.note: Blue Owl, Apollo, Ares, BlackRock and others capped withdrawals; ~$4.6B trapped as of March, Q2 requests ran 17–38% at some funds

auto.note: NY Fed: flow into 90+ day delinquency 3.00%; serious delinquency highest since 2010

cre.note: Trepp office CMBS delinquency (overall 7.85%); peak was 12.34% in Jan

bankruptcies.note: S&P Global: large US filings, most since 2010; small-business filings +50% y/y

earnings.note: FactSet: Q3 EPS estimates rose during the quarter vs a usual 2–2.5% cut; Q3 growth seen at 29.5%
